items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/s1: start-run responded after the run awaited verdicts; effects 1-9 stamp,pin,checklist,self-check,fence,regenerate,install,self-check,gate all recorded; gate events [regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed].

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/fence: R-1/C-1 failed at fence; start R-1/C-2 refused run-already-started; progress all lists R-1 once, cycle C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first awaits its verdicts
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/s1: with R-1 awaiting-verdicts, start R-2/C-2 refused run-in-progress; progress all holds only R-1, still awaiting-verdicts.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/s1: after R-1/C-1 passed, start R-2/C-1 refused cycle-already-run; no R-2 in progress.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/t005: commit deadbeef... refused not-a-commit; progress R-1 null, runs []; no builder launch recorded.

items.name: A run whose context does not respond on its seam is refused

items.name: Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's order
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s/s1: relays: scenario-stamped #1,#2 -> measurement, source-cut-pinned #1 -> measurement and regeneration-cycle, gate-attempt-passed #1 -> measurement once; all accepted.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s/t008: checklist effect refused empty-checklist (measurement); halted at checklist, refused-before-the-cycle; effects=3, no self-check/fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s/t009: stamp recorded (3 scenario-stamped events); halted at stamp, refused-before-the-cycle, detail plan [01-001 01-002] vs stamp [01-001 01-002 01-003]; effects=1, no pin/checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: s/t010: run failed, cycle failure {stage fence, reason harness-self-check-failed, detail 'golden checklist differs'}; last effect pos 4 self-check; no fence/regenerate.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: s/t011: first self-check recorded harness-self-check-passed, skipped-checks ['bb-tools'], detail '...skipped checks: bb-tools'.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: s/fence (commit holds impl only): fence refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, fail-cycle recorded next, run failed at fence for fence-refused; no builder launch-count file.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: s/s1/launch-1: builder room held docs/plan/01-a/spec.feature, harness/config.sh, empty impl/; 1 commit, 1 root; no impl or harness/cycles path in tree or rev-list --objects --all.

items.name: Each regenerate launches one builder and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t014: red then green: launched twice (regenerate a1, repair a2); launch-1 ended 1794208638.68, launch-2 started 1794208642.61.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t015: builder exits 1 leaving green candidate; regenerate recorded with digest sha256:0a20d6..., detail 'the builder exited 1'; run awaits verdicts.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t016: empty scope: no regenerate effect, fail-cycle recorded; cycle failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget

items.evidence: s/t017: regenerate timeout 2s, builder sleeps 30: builder pid dead when start responded and never woke (checked 32s later); cycle failed at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only

items.evidence: s/t024: always red: builder launched 3 times (launch-count 3), regenerate+2 repairs, cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.
